name: Automations
description: Visual editor for the hub's automation kernel: when something happens, do this. A vertical spine, not a node canvas.

agent.description: Visual editor for the hub automations (flows): create, edit, enable and pause automations that react to an event, a schedule or a manual trigger; grant them what they may do; and read their run history in plain language. It does not run the automations — the hub's own kernel does.
